name: gap_continuation_momentum_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps up > 0.4% at open on global cues or FII-driven overnight information, institutions with unfinished buy programs allow price to consolidate during 09:15-09:30 as the opening order queue clears. When NIFTY then closes above the 15-minute post-open range high (ORB high), VWAP-benchmarked algorithms — still below their target allocation — trigger systematic buy orders simultaneously, creating a 30-90 second directional burst. At 5-second resolution we enter at the exact ORB breakout bar rather than waiting for a 1-minute confirmation, capturing the first 10-15 spot points of institutional flow resumption before the burst exhausts. The inverse holds for gap-down: break below ORB low on a gap-down day signals continued institutional selling.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap > 0.4% day: first 5s close above 15-min ORB high (gap-up) or below ORB low (gap-down) with volume surge > 1.2x and VWAP alignment
